title: VCR Frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of an i-SASE Verification and Closure Record (VCR). A VCR documents the resolution of a CRP or MRP, capturing the decision and who made it.

schema.description: Schema identifier for the VCR artifact type.

id.description: Unique 12-character hex identifier for the VCR.

resolves.description: Identifier of the CRP or MRP that this VCR resolves.

resolved-by.description: Person or entity that made the resolution decision.

decision-type.description: Type of decision recorded by this VCR.
